name: Fighter Blade Dancer (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
Blade dancers take sword combat to another level, treating their swords as a spiritual companion. They turn combat into a deadly dance and some even sing or recite poetry while fighting.

Acrobatics (Ex)

Blade dancers are much more acrobatic than other warriors. They gain Acrobatics as a class skill and add their class level as a bonus to Acrobatics skill checks.

This ability replaces the bonus feat granted at 1st level.

Cloud Leap (Su)

Beginning with 2nd level, a blade dancer does not double the DC for Acrobatics checks to jump from not having a running start.

This ability replaces all instances of bravery.

Fast Movement (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, a blade dancer gains fast movement as a monk of their class level.

This ability replaces all instances of armor training and armor mastery.

Enchanted Blade (Su)

At 4th level, a blade dancer gains the ability to enhance one of their swords with divine power as a swift action. This power grants the weapon a +1 enhancement bonus. For every 4 levels beyond 4th, this bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +5 at 20th level). If the blade dancer has more than one sword, they can enhance another on the following round by using another swift action. A blade dancer can use this ability a number of rounds per day equal to their fighter level, but these rounds need not be consecutive.

These bonuses stack with any existing bonuses the weapon might have, to a maximum of +5. A blade dancer can enhance a weapon with any weapon special abilities they would not normally be prevented from wielding or using. Adding any of these special abilities replaces an amount of bonus equal to the special ability’s base cost. Duplicate abilities do not stack. The weapon must have at least a +1 enhancement bonus before any other special abilities can be added.

If multiple weapons are enhanced, each one consumes rounds of use individually. The enhancement bonus and special abilities are determined the first time the ability is used each day, and cannot be changed until the next day. These bonuses do not apply if another creature is wielding the weapon, but they continue to be in effect if the weapon otherwise leaves the blade dancer’s possession (such as if the weapon is thrown).

This ability can be ended as a free action at the start of the blade dancer’s turn (that round does not count against the total duration, unless the ability is resumed during the same round). If a blade dancer uses this ability on a double weapon, the effects apply to only one end of the weapon.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 4th, 10th, and 16th levels.

Weapon Training (Ex)

A blade dancer must select weapon groups that include swords and only may apply the bonuses to sword weapons.

This ability alters weapon training.

Acrobatic Attack (Ex)

At 6th level, if a blade dancer attacks by jumping at least 5 feet toward their opponent, jumping down at least 5 feet onto their opponent or swinging on a rope or similar object into his opponent, they gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls. The blade dancer must make an Acrobatics check; if the result is less than 5 feet, they cannot use this ability on that attack. If the result is greater than the distance between the blade dancer and the opponent, the blade dancer can limit the distance to that between himself and the opponent as a free action.

Ride the Wind (Sp)

At 12th level, a blade dancer can use air walk as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to their Dexterity modifier. The caster level for this effect is equal to their class level.

Breath of Life: The Geomancer, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC; Authors: Connor Bates, Norman Mitchell Jr., and Paulo César Viola Da Silva Maia.
